definition.default:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Render chart]
    B -->|No| D[Update definition]

securityLevel.description: Mermaid security level. Keep strict for untrusted diagram definitions.

showError.description: Show Mermaid parse/render errors in the component.

fitMode.description: How the rendered diagram is fit into the component viewport.

padding.description: Padding in pixels around the rendered diagram.

zoom.description: Zoom behavior for the rendered diagram.

enabled.description: Allow the diagram to be zoomed.

showControls.description: Show zoom buttons over the diagram.

wheelModifier.description: Wheel zoom needs Ctrl/Cmd held, so a plain wheel still scrolls the page. False zooms on a plain wheel.

initial.description: Initial zoom multiplier applied after fitting.

step.description: Zoom increment used by buttons and wheel zoom.

zoomLevel.description: Current zoom multiplier. Updated by the component when zoom controls or wheel zoom change.

download.description: Download options for exporting the rendered diagram.

enabled.description: Allow the diagram to be downloaded.

showControls.description: Show the Download button over the diagram.

svg.description: Offer SVG (vector) download in the format menu.

edit.description: Graphical flowchart editing in the Designer.

enabled.description: Show the graphical editor in the Designer (double-click the diagram)

default.definition:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Decision}
    B -->|Yes| C[Render chart]
    B -->|No| D[Update definition]
